name: @w6w-apps/kintone
description: Read, write and search records in a Kintone app, plus comments, files and form metadata, via each customer's own Kintone REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
Kintone (Cybozu) is a no-code database/app builder: every customer runs their own tenant at `https://<subdomain>.cybozu.com` or `https://<subdomain>.kintone.com`, and every Kintone "App" inside that tenant is its own record schema the customer designs, not a fixed shape this integration can assume. So, like `bubble`, `mautic` and `tableau` in this pack, the tenant's own URL is a connection field and the field-value shapes are passed through as the raw objects Kintone's REST API documents (`{"FieldCode": {"value": ...}}`), rather than guessed at.

This app covers the REST API surface that a per-App API Token can reach: single and bulk record create/read/update/delete, a query-string search over a Kintone App's records, comments, file upload/download, and the two read-only App metadata calls (general info, form fields) documented as API-Token-authenticated. Left out on purpose: listing every App in the tenant and anything about Kintone's own Users/Groups/Spaces admin surface, because those require Password, Session or OAuth 2.0 authentication — a Kintone API Token is deliberately scoped to one App and cannot reach them (verified against Kintone's own Authentication reference; see the README).
